content.value_statement: Vue Router apps can fail when guards, params, and lifecycle hooks are misunderstood. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code targeted guidance for safer routing patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains Vue Router guard execution and when each guard runs.
Guides fixes for param changes that bypass beforeEnter or lifecycle hooks.
Provides examples for async guard handling, redirects, lazy routes, and route meta.
Helps migrate away from deprecated next guard patterns.
Covers cleanup for hashchange listeners in simple routing prototypes.
limitations: Does not install Vue Router or modify project files by itself.
Focuses on Vue 3 and Vue Router 4 patterns.
Does not replace testing against app-specific auth and routing rules.
Examples require adaptation to each project structure and naming convention.

use_cases.title: Fix Guard Bugs
use_cases.description: Diagnose navigation guards that allow stale data, missed auth checks, or redirect loops.

use_cases.title: Review Routing Architecture
use_cases.description: Check production SPA routing for lazy loading, route meta, lifecycle behavior, and cleanup gaps.

use_cases.title: Guide AI Code Changes
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code focused routing context before editing Vue Router code.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Routes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing router setup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Vue Router setup for common guard, params, lifecycle, and redirect issues. Explain the likely impact and fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Param Updates
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate fix for stale data on same-route navigation.
prompt_templates.prompt: My Vue component shows stale data when the route param changes. Identify the likely Vue Router cause and suggest the best fix.

prompt_templates.title: Modernize Guards
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cleanup of old navigation guard patterns.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these navigation guards for deprecated next usage, missing async handling, redirect loops, and route meta improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Protected Routing
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture review for auth-sensitive routing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this protected Vue Router flow for access-control bypasses, missed param changes, async failures, and production routing risks.

output_examples.input: A user profile page shows old data after moving from one user ID to another.
output: Identifies component reuse as the likely cause.
Recommends watching route params or using an update guard.
Explains when forcing component recreation is appropriate.

output_examples.input: An auth guard sometimes lets users through before the auth check finishes.
output: Flags unawaited async checks as the routing risk.
Suggests explicit async handling, redirects, and error fallback paths.
Calls out loading and timeout behavior for slow services.

output_examples.input: A production SPA still uses simple hash routing.
output: Compares manual routing gaps with Vue Router features.
Recommends Vue Router for guards, lazy loading, history mode, and nested routes.
Notes listener cleanup risks in simple routing prototypes.

best_practices: Use route meta and named routes for guard decisions.
Handle same-route param changes with watchers or update guards.
Await async guard checks and provide explicit error paths.
anti_patterns: Relying on beforeEnter for same-route param changes.
Calling deprecated next patterns without one clear control path.
Redirecting to protected or guest routes without loop guards.

faq.question: What Vue versions does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Vue 3 and Vue Router 4 patterns.

faq.question: Can it update my app automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance that an AI coding tool or developer can apply.

faq.question: Does it cover authentication routing?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers common auth guard patterns, redirects, async checks, and route meta usage.

faq.question: Does it replace the official Vue Router docs?
faq.answer: No. It complements the docs with focused gotchas and practical review prompts.

faq.question: Can Claude Code and Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code assisted Vue Router work.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It highlights guard issues that can affect access control, but app-specific tests remain necessary.
